messages:
mia: quick pulse check before the review  we need a clear plan for bookmarkable console pages + compact sidebar accessibility
ron: yes. main ask from support: shared links must render previews and land on the right panel, not a generic dashboard
helen: ops constraint: that means history routing + server rewrite for known entity routes so OG meta can be injected. hash-only won't cut it
arjun: agreed. prefer canonical paths like /orgs/:orgId/projects/:projectId/models/:modelId. also add short aliases (/m/:id) that redirect to canonical for chat convenience
mia: sidebar IA: split "Workloads" into explicit 'Models' and 'Deploys' under an "AI" group. allow compact (icon-only) mode but keep semantics for screen readers
ron: compact nav should preserve DOM order and include sr-only labels. keyboard users must still see logical focus order when arrowing through items
helen: breadcrumb rules: shallow only. Org > Project > Models > {display name}. do not include intermediate collection stubs. fallback to slug if name missing
arjun: deep-link to panels: use query param ?tab=metrics rather than hash. if we need fragment scrolling we can trigger it on hydration after checking query param
mia: microcopy rule: collection pages use plural nouns ('Models'), detail H1 use singular ('Model') with version suffix when relevant
nav-bot: routing-scan: propose routes for devs:
```
/projects/:projectId/models
/projects/:projectId/models/:modelId
/projects/:projectId/deploys/:deployId
/m/:legacyModelId -> redirect
/d/:legacyDeployId -> redirect
```
we should auto-resolve org where possible for legacy aliases
ron: a11y note: ensure role=navigation on left nav, aria-expanded on group toggles, aria-current='page' on active link, and a visible skip-to-content link as first focusable element
a11y-bot: flagged missing focus management in prototype. recommendation: on route change move focus to page H1 (tabindex='-1' then focus()) and use aria-live polite for transient toasts like 'Opened from shortcuts'\mто?mia: pinned shortcuts idea: let users pin items and expose /shortcuts/:userId. when opening via a pin show the canonical breadcrumb and a small toast 'Opened from your shortcuts'
arjun: telemetry: emit deep_link_open with origin = nav|pin|share so we can measure landing sources\helen: ops action: we can add a tiny metadata cache served by rewrite rules. need list of canonical patterns to whitelist and a TTL on entries to avoid DB hits for each preview
ron: dev acceptance: e2e tests for keyboard-only nav, pinned open, deep-link landing with correct OG meta, and redirect coverage for aliases
mia: copy tasks: write plural/singular decisions and truncation rules for breadcrumbs on small screens\a11y-bot: accessibility checklist summary: skip link, role=navigation, aria-expanded, aria-controls for flyouts, aria-current on active items, focus H1 on navigation, pinned region role:list, aria-live for toasts\mто?mia: ok folks, i'll collate notes and add to the design PR. design review tomorrow 11:30 — will demo compact nav + deep-link flows. thanks :sparkles:
